    profile AS p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN 
    sessionbehavior AS sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN 
    networkmetrics AS nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
ORDER BY 
    nm.network_engagement_metrics->'engagement_metrics'->>'engauth' ASC
LIMIT 10;
